description: This PHP class 'Credit' extends the Opencart System Engine Model and manages customer credit totals within orders, including calculating credit, confirming, and unconfirming transactions.

classes.name: Credit
classes.description: Manages customer credit total calculations and transaction management within orders.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates the credit deduction for an order based on the customer's balance.

methods.name: confirm
methods.description: Records a credit transaction when an order is confirmed.

methods.name: unconfirm
methods.description: Removes credit transactions associated with an order when unconfirmed.
